title: Bioinformatic Analysis of Biomarker Genes Using Metagenomic Shotgun Sequence Datasets
author: Fernando Espinola
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u32eyqe

steps.title: Select metagenomes by ID
steps.instruction: In IMG, click Find Genomes → Genome Search → Quick Search, choose “Search by ID”, paste the IDs 3300000122, 3300000242, 3300000118, 3300000121, 3300000131, 3300000125 separated by commas, and press Search.

steps.title: Add genomes to cart and verify
steps.instruction: Check the boxes of all retrieved genomes and click “Add selected to Genome Cart”. Optionally export the list to an Excel file. Confirm that the number of genomes shown in the “My Analysis Carts” bar matches the number you selected.

steps.title: Set KO table parameters
steps.instruction: Generate a KO abundance matrix with the following settings:

substeps.instruction: Go to the menu → Compare Genomes → Abundance Profiles → Overview (all functions).
Set Normalization Method to “Genome count (estimated gene copies)”.
Ensure the source is the metagenomes you added to the cart.
In the Genome option, select both “assembled” and “unassembled”.
For Metagenome and Sequencing status, select all: “finished”, “permanent draft”, and “draft for MER‑FS”.

steps.title: Download KO table
steps.instruction: When the results screen appears, click the Download tab and choose “tab‑delimited file for Excel” to save the KO table.

steps.title: Normalize KO abundances
steps.instruction: Open the downloaded table (KO terms in rows, samples in columns). For each sample column, sum all KO counts to obtain the total sequence count for that sample, then divide each KO count by that column total to get normalized abundance. Repeat for every sample in the dataset.
